::: {.notes}
The publisher’s Music 3 demo includes this recording with a structured caption specifying BPM, key, vocal character, instruments and song sections. The generated song can deviate from these instructions. The competing YuE2 team evaluated its own samples on 192 WildSongBench prompts.

This slide plays 0:28–0:46 of the published recording. The local copy is an 18-second stereo MP3 with a brief fade at each cut.
